No intermittent consensus issue surfaced.
- Recorded the result and caveat in the report.

- **Graded module:** unmodified upstream `hashicorp/raft v1.7.3` (proven byte-for-byte). No injected defect.

- **Two concrete defects, both outside consensus logic:**

  - C2 — stale `fuzzy` transport omits the pre-vote case (root-caused; the one-case fix makes the whole fuzzy suite pass).
- **Remaining blocker:** `raft-compat` needs the unchecked-out `raft-previous-version` submodule.

The audit is comprehensive; further work would be reiteration. I'll stop here unless you want a specific follow-up (e.g., reviving `raft-compat`, or writing a C1 upstream-style patch).
